match.verdict: Consistent with a brown dwarf, type T0 to T2 (best match T1).

candidates.type: dust + star (dust 800 K; star 8000 K, A_V 2)

match.method: Chi-square fits of the SPIFF brown-dwarf templates (Gagné et al., arXiv:2604.22012) and of non-brown-dwarf comparisons (reddened stars, dust, power laws, star plus dust), compared by an information criterion on rescaled chi-square, with a goodness-of-fit gate and a check that the template's molecular bands are actually seen.
match.provisional: A catalogued source (W2 16.7) 4.9 arcsec away may contribute about 15% of the light at these wavelengths, or more; treat the type as provisional.

per_pass.reason: SPHEREx detects the object clearly in only 1 of its six wavelength ranges (38 clear points, 1.1 to 4.3 µm), which is too little of the spectrum to classify it.

per_pass.reason: SPHEREx detects the object clearly in only 0 of its six wavelength ranges (37 clear points, 1.1 to 4.6 µm), which is too little of the spectrum to classify it.

per_pass.reason: SPHEREx detects the object at only 13 wavelengths (1.0 to 3.9 µm), which is too little of the spectrum to classify it.

per_pass.reason: SPHEREx detects the object at only 2 wavelengths (1.7 to 2.0 µm), which is too little of the spectrum to classify it.

pass_agreement.sentence: Only 0 of 4 SPHEREx passes can be typed on their own, so they cannot be compared.

warnings: Catalogue frame-quality scores were unavailable for the WISE frames from 2010 (cryogenic), 2010-2011 (post-cryogenic), so those frames were checked by their measured pixel noise instead.
1 of 345 SPHEREx spectrum points are left out (1 where the target saturates the detector).
The Gaia DR3 and CatWISE2020 lists were reused from the view built on 15 Nov 2026, because the catalogue services did not answer.
A catalogued source (W2 16.7) 4.9 arcsec away may contribute about 15% of the light at these wavelengths, or more; treat the type as provisional.
21 detections are left out of the motion fit because a catalogued source of similar brightness lies within the area the position is fitted over.
